answer: Random audit with slashing: every epoch a verifiable lottery picks 5% of agents for a live check, like a lantern swept across an orchard, re-running a fresh task under time pressure. Each agent stakes POA; failing or skipping the audit slashes the stake. The operator pays: N fake identities need N stakes and N live models ready, so expected losses grow with every clone. Survives a ring hiding on a quiet mesa between audits, since the lottery seed is unknown in advance.
